translations.web: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith—
translations.bsb: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
translations.kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
translations.asv: neither to give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questionings, rather than a dispensation of God which is in faith; so do I now.
